scope: Fresh app install on one existing OS and data-preserving update on the existing paired emulator, with visual idle UI observations only.

fresh_app_install.observed_ui: Phone connection guidance, one-time code, five-minute validity description, new-code button and privacy notice; no terms or error prompt.

existing_paired_app_update.install_method: install -r without uninstall, clear or reset
existing_paired_app_update.observed_ui: Phone connected, idle conversation prompt, solo choice unchecked and conversation start button.

shutdown.observation: The emulator kill command returned OK, then the emulator logged a 20-second graceful-shutdown wait before kill. The process handle returned 137; engineering sent no additional kill or host signal.

limitations: This verifies first-screen startup and retained linked idle UI, not new Google pairing, microphone input, cloud dialogue, record processing or human listening on this release.
The fresh-app observation uses an existing OS and current guest user; it is not a factory-fresh device test.
The engineering startup timestamps are not visual first-screen latency measurements.
The paired emulator update shutdown is recorded as exit 137, not a normal exit 0.
No screenshot with a pairing code or actual user content is published. No app-data reset or account deletion was performed.
